text: The one breaking change is #14002 in External File Storage, which now rejects any path with a whole segment of "." or ".." for all operations and connectors, so DeleteDirectory('A/B/..') no longer acts on folder A. Callers passing relative segments now get an error; dots inside names stay valid. #14059 moves the No. Series Copilot to the GPT-5.6 Ceres managed deployment, replacing GPT-4.1, for content provenance compliance. #14007 discontinues Create Product Information with Copilot: install and upgrade code unregister its capability, the Item Substitution Entry page shows a notification pointing to modern search, other objects are marked obsolete pending in 30.0, and the table extension fields move to Removed in 33.0. #13558 makes the Microsoft Fabric Mirroring app export its two log tables automatically, with install and upgrade codeunits changed for new and existing installations. #13868 corrects the sign on the Czech VAT Statement report with the Opposite Sign option. #13807 shows Total Number of Supplies in the German VAT Report as a whole number. #13717 stops one vendor's missing email from clearing another vendor's Document No. in electronic payments export. #13243 fixes GST and import duty entries for partially received purchase orders from Import and SEZ vendors. #14118 is a refactor of the Indexes List Part page with no behaviour change.

issues: Every claim matches the week's pull requests: all 9 numbers are correct, and the only breaking change is #14002, which is the one flagged as breaking.
